action.sql: SELECT v.vendor_id, v.name AS vendor_name, SUM(b.amount) AS total_billed FROM ap_bills b JOIN vendors v ON v.vendor_id = b.vendor_id WHERE b.entity_id = 'CA01' AND b.bill_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND b.bill_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY v.vendor_id, v.name ORDER BY total_billed DESC LIMIT 3
